lines.speaker: mattie_tolliver
lines.text: Then it's not for sale. Not this year, not to them, and it says so in writing now — which is the only kind of saying that lasts longer than the person saying it.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Provenance. That is the whole of it, isn't it. One line, on one deed, about who owns a corner shop.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It is a corner shop on a block nobody will remember. Write it down anyway: the record of who owned a thing, and when, and on whose word.
